entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Pierre-Marc-Gaston de Lévis, 2nd Duke of Lévis, second duke of Lévis, peer of France, was a French politician, aphorist, and soldier. At the French Revolution he was a deputy of the National Constituent Assembly. He published several books and was a member of the Académie française.
